verdicts.decision_note: The client requests an architectural-plan position for each of the three new bathrooms, establishing the Unit 3 bathroom layout.
The source establishes a general drainage-alignment constraint for bathroom toilets and does not specifically modify the Unit 3 fixture layout; it is better routed to REQ_BATHROOM_DRAINAGE_ALIGNMENT.
The client explicitly moves the Unit 3 bathroom drain and shower to the left wall, changing the architectural and plumbing layout without leaving a stale prior location.
